# v2.64-dev Release Notes

## Fixed: exported "Detail" now matches the on-screen wording

On **Programs › Compliance Planning**, the "Who to certify" / "All eligible
candidates" drill-down reads as plain-language sentences on screen, but the exported
report's **Detail** column still used the old terse format (e.g. *"Security Service
Edge Engineer (UKI) via …/EDU-318 [Easy win]"*).

The export now emits the **same sentence** as the screen — one per gap the person
closes, on its own line — e.g. *"They have taken Training A. Passing the Cert A
certification exam will contribute to the Specialisation Y specialisation. (Program X
· UKI)"*. This applies to the per-section export and the whole-page **Export report**
(CSV/Excel/PDF). The two now share a single wording source, so they can't drift apart
again.
